name: [Anypoint MQ] High In-Flight Messages
message:
{{#is_alert}}
⚠️ **High in-flight messages — consumers may be struggling**

| | |
|---|---|
| **Queue** | `{{queue_name.name}}` |
| **Environment** | `{{environment.name}}` |
| **In Flight** | {{value}} |

**What this means:** Consumers are fetching messages but not acknowledging them quickly. This typically indicates:
- Slow downstream service responses
- Consumer resource exhaustion (CPU/memory)
- Message processing timeouts

If in-flight messages exceed the queue's lock TTL, they will be redelivered — causing duplicate processing.

**Actions:**
1. Check consumer processing times and error rates
2. Verify downstream service latency
3. Consider increasing consumer lock TTL or scaling out
